description: This file defines the DynamoDBWrapper class, which is a Python class interfacing with DynamoDB via the aiodynamo library. It is marked as deprecated and only supports PostgreSQL, hinting it is part of a larger codebase with database abstractions. The class manages DynamoDB connections, credentials, and environment setup based on AWS roles.

classes.name: DynamoDBWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for DynamoDB operations, extending CustomDB, managing credentials, throughput settings, and environment variables based on AWS roles.

methods.name: __init__(self, database_arguments: DynamoDBArgs)
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDBWrapper with specified database arguments, setting throughput mode and validating capacity units.

methods.name: set_env_vars_based_on_arn(self)
methods.description: Sets AWS environment variables for access based on the provided AWS role ARN, performing role assumption via STS.
